tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows leukocytosis (elevated white blood cells), which may indicate infection, inflammation, or other causes. All red blood cell parameters and platelets are within normal limits. However, the platelet distribution width is markedly elevated, suggesting increased variability in platelet size, which can be seen in reactive states or platelet disorders. Clinical correlation is recommended.
